title: EQuake
wikitext:
eQuake was a QuakeWorld package aiming to be the only thing QuakeWorld players would need to download to play a relatively competitive game, and was released on the 30th of September [[2003]]. Development of eQuake slowly reached its end in the summer of [[2004]], and after about 3 years of being THE QuakeWorld package, [[fQuake]] was released and replaced eQuake in the hearts of QuakeWorld players all over the world. == Contributors == Everything: [[image:flag_se.gif]] [[Empezar]]
Mirror provider: [[image:flag_se.gif]] [[mescon]]

Note: the contents of eQuake was _not_ made by [[Empezar]], who only gathered the content and made eQuake. == Deprecation == eQuake was deprecated in early 2007, and can no longer be downloaded. If you wish to download QuakeWorld, give [[NQuake]] a try. [[Category:Packages]]
